title: KDP Paperback Font Pre-flight Rules
note: Derived from one KDP help page reading; page changes; nothing executed; no acceptance guaranteed.

rules.name: minimum_font_size
rules.check: Select all in Word; inspect font-size field

rules.name: body_font_readability
rules.check: Print/render one full body page at final size
rules.failure: Ornate or illegible at page length
rules.fix: Switch to a named body option (see R03)

rules.name: named_body_fonts
rules.condition: Font name matches a KDP-listed option
rules.check: Verify font name in document/PDF properties
rules.failure: Name not in list and no licence verified
rules.fix: Use listed name or verify licence

rules.name: sample_page_reviewed
rules.condition: One full body page reviewed before submission
rules.check: Confirm review at final size and tone
rules.fix: Set sample pages; review before export

rules.name: licence_verified
rules.condition: Licence confirmed for each font used
rules.check: Locate licence file or vendor page per font
rules.note: Page: 'You are responsible for securing the required licenses.'

rules.name: fonts_embed_in_pdf
rules.condition: All fonts show Embedded or Embedded Subset in Acrobat
rules.check: Single-font test PDF; Acrobat > File > Properties > Fonts

rules.name: no_low_quality_fonts
rules.condition: No incomplete, badly drawn or misaligned glyphs
rules.fix: Replace with font from reputable source

rules.name: word_embed_setting
rules.condition: Word save option: Embed fonts checked; two sub-options unchecked

rules.name: no_rejected_fonts
rules.condition: No font flagged by KDP Previewer anywhere in file
rules.check: Run KDP Previewer; inspect all locations on error
rules.fix: Replace font in every hiding place; resubmit

rules.name: no_faux_fonts
rules.condition: No synthetic bold/italic where true variant is absent
rules.check: Select bold/italic text; check whether font name changes
rules.failure: Font name unchanged on Bold/Italic text
rules.fix: Use true bold/italic font file; remove synthetic formatting
